property_summary: For every call to Put by any actor with any msg.value, the reference C always leaves the Log contract in a state where calling Log.History(uint) for the index equal to Log.History.length-1 returns a Message whose Sender equals the caller (i.e., the last log entry's Sender == tx.originating caller); the mutant that removed AddMessage can leave the Log unchanged so this equality can fail for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace the LogFile.AddMessage call with a no-op (deleted), removing the logging side-effect observable via the Log contract history after Put.
